units.source_text: 我们有目的地等候着这女子。

en.t: We waited for this woman with a purpose.

units.source_text: 春光洒满了大地，对面雄峙着深蓝色的比睿山的山峰，这边出现了渐渐走过来的女子。

en.t: Spring light flooded the earth; opposite us rose the deep blue peak of Mount Hiei, and on this side the woman slowly walking toward us came into view.

units.source_text: 我还没有从方才柏木讲述的那番话所引起的感动中苏醒过来。

en.t: I had not yet awakened from the emotion stirred in me by what Kashiwagi had just said.
It was a strange thing to say:

units.source_text: 他的X型的腿和她仿佛是两颗星星，彼此不相接触，散在实像的世界里，

en.t: His X-shaped legs and she were like two stars, never touching each other, scattered through the world of real images,

units.source_text: 他本人则无限地埋没在虚像的世界，以逐步实现他的欲望。

en.t: while he himself sank endlessly into the world of false images, gradually realizing his desire.

units.source_text: 这时，浮云遮挡了太阳，我和柏木笼罩在淡薄的阴影之下，

en.t: Just then, drifting clouds covered the sun, and Kashiwagi and I were enveloped in a faint shadow,

units.source_text: 我觉得我们的世界仿佛顿时露出了虚像的姿影。

en.t: and I felt as though our world had suddenly revealed the form of a false image.

units.source_text: 一切都变成灰色，捉摸不定，连自我的存在也变成不可捉摸了，

en.t: Everything turned gray and elusive, and even the existence of the self became impossible to grasp,

units.source_text: 惟有远方比睿山的紫蓝色山峰和缓慢走过来的高雅女子在实像的世界里闪烁，

en.t: while only the violet-blue peak of distant Mount Hiei and the elegant woman slowly walking toward us glittered in the world of real images,

units.source_text: 似乎谁有这两样东西才是实实在在的存在。

en.t: as if whoever possessed these two things alone truly existed.
